actions.title: Multi-planar view (three planes)
actions.label: Multi-planar
actions.help: Sagittal, coronal and axial slices through the crosshair, side by side (multi-planar reconstruction, MPR)

actions.title: 3-D volume rendering
actions.label: 3-D
actions.help: The whole volume ray-cast on the graphics card: surfaces, projections, clip planes

actions.title: Multi-planar view with 3-D rendering
actions.label: Planes + 3-D
actions.help: The three slices and the 3-D rendering together, one crosshair

actions.title: One large view, the others beside it
actions.label: Large view
actions.help: The chosen plane (or the 3-D) drawn large, the rest small beside it; drag the gap to resize

actions.title: Mosaic of many slices (lightbox)
actions.label: Mosaic
actions.help: Many slices of one plane in a grid, for a quick look through the volume or a figure

actions.title: Time-course graph
actions.label: Time course
actions.help: The signal over time at the crosshair (4-D images), with the run's events, physiology and quality rows when asked

actions.title: Time course beside the views
actions.label: Beside
actions.help: Put the time-course panel to the right of the views instead of under them (a long run reads better wide, a tall one beside)

actions.title: Maximise the time course
actions.label: Maximise
actions.help: Give the time-course panel the whole viewer (its QC plots and physiology too); again to bring the views back

actions.title: Time course in its own window
actions.label: Own window
actions.help: Move the time-course panel to a window of its own (a second screen, say); closing that window puts it back

actions.title: Orientation labels and cube
actions.label: Orientation labels
actions.help: Letters at the edges of every slice (R/L, A/P, S/I) and the orientation cube in 3-D

actions.title: RAS orientation
actions.label: RAS
actions.help: Draw every image Right, Anterior, Superior up the axes, whatever order its file stores the voxels in. Off: the file's own storage order

actions.title: Radiological convention
actions.label: Radiological
actions.help: Mirror left and right, as radiologists read images: the patient's left on the screen's right. Off: neurological convention

actions.title: World space
actions.label: World space
actions.help: Resample slices onto the scanner's axes, so an oblique acquisition is drawn upright. Off: slices of the image's own voxel grid

actions.title: Colour bar
actions.label: Colour bar
actions.help: A colour bar under the image for every scalar layer, with its window, units and threshold

actions.title: Crosshair
actions.label: Crosshair
actions.help: The crosshair on every slice and in 3-D (its colour and width in Slice views)

actions.title: Next volume of this shell
actions.label: Next volume of this shell
actions.help: Step through every volume of the shell on screen: how a bad direction is found

actions.title: Next shell
actions.label: Next shell
actions.help: The first volume of the next b-value

actions.title: Next run
actions.label: Next run
actions.help: The same image of the next run, crosshair where it was

actions.title: Next subject
actions.label: Next subject
actions.help: The same image of the next subject

actions.title: Preview defacing
actions.label: Preview defacing
actions.help: What the defacing engine would blank, drawn in red over the image. Nothing is changed

actions.title: Window to the robust range
actions.label: Auto
actions.help: The display range from the 1st to the 99th percentile of this volume

actions.title: Window for the whole series
actions.label: Window for the whole series
actions.help: One display range for every volume of the series, so playing it does not flicker

actions.title: Window to the full range
actions.label: Full
actions.help: The display range from the smallest to the largest value

actions.title: Nearest-neighbour interpolation
actions.label: Nearest neighbour
actions.help: Draw each voxel as a square, as the data is, instead of smoothing between voxels

actions.title: Cut through the crosshair
actions.label: Cut through the crosshair
actions.help: Every clip plane passes through the crosshair: the cut faces are the slices the 2-D views show, and follow them

actions.title: Corner cut at the crosshair
actions.label: Corner cut at the crosshair
actions.help: Cut out the corner facing you, at the crosshair: the three slices in 3-D

actions.title: Header and sidecar...
actions.label: Header
actions.help: The image's header beside its sidecar, every disagreement said: repetition time, slice timing, b-values, units, orientation

actions.title: Add an overlay...
actions.label: Add overlay
actions.help: Draw another image over this one: a statistical map, an atlas, a mask, another contrast. Its look follows from what it holds.

actions.title: Check image quality
actions.label: Check quality
actions.help: The fast quality check of an anatomical or diffusion image: noise, contrast, artefacts, tissues, coverage, the gradient table, motion and slice dropout, each finding with its evidence over the image. The air is measured only in images that are not defaced.

actions.title: Quality panel below the views
actions.label: Below
actions.help: Put the quality panel under the views and the time course instead of beside them

actions.title: Maximise the quality panel
actions.label: Maximise
actions.help: Give the quality panel the room of the views (below: of the views and the time course); again to bring them back

actions.title: Quality panel in its own window
actions.label: Own window
actions.help: Move the quality panel to a window of its own; closing that window puts it back

actions.title: Show the noise
actions.label: Show the noise
actions.help: The image windowed to its air, in colour: ghosts, ringing, motion and wrap-around show as structure where there should be noise. Again to put the look back.

actions.title: Mean image of the series
actions.label: Mean image
actions.help: Computed when chosen: the mean over every volume, as an overlay

actions.title: Standard deviation map
actions.label: Standard deviation
actions.help: Computed when chosen: where the signal moves over time (motion at the edges, vessels, ghosts), as an overlay

actions.title: Temporal SNR map
actions.label: Temporal SNR
actions.help: Computed when chosen: each voxel's mean over its standard deviation after removing slow drifts, as an overlay with a colour bar and how to read it

actions.title: Advanced controls
actions.label: Advanced controls
actions.help: Every control, grouped by purpose: for images the layers and their look, the view, the layout and the 3-D; for signals the channels, time, filters, events, QC and display; for spectra what is shown, the processing, the reference marks and QC

actions.title: Fit the whole recording
actions.label: Fit all
actions.help: Put the whole recording in the window at once

actions.title: Normalise each channel
actions.label: Normalise
actions.help: Each channel scaled to its own range, so none overlaps; off, channels of one type share a scale

actions.title: Butterfly: every channel of a type in one band
actions.label: Butterfly
actions.help: Overlay the channels of each type, to see what they share

actions.title: Clip traces to their band
actions.label: Clip traces
actions.help: Cut a trace off at one and a half bands, so an artefact cannot paint over its neighbours

actions.title: Remove each channel's mean
actions.label: Remove DC
actions.help: Centre each trace in its band (the mean over the window taken out)

actions.title: Scale each page to itself
actions.label: Scale per page
actions.help: Off: one amplitude per channel type for the whole recording, so a quiet page and a noisy one compare. On: each page fills its bands.

actions.title: Quality control (QC)
actions.label: QC
actions.help: A quick check before a full pipeline, computed when switched on and type by type (magnetometers, gradiometers and EEG are never mixed): channels that are noisy, flat, uncorrelated or carry line noise, by STD and peak-to-peak; and the segments where a type's channels go off or muscle shows. Its parameters are in the advanced controls

actions.title: Annotation mode
actions.label: Annotate
actions.help: Mark bad segments: drag across the traces to mark one, drag its edges to adjust it, right-click it to relabel or delete it. Channel names mark channels bad in any mode.

actions.title: Delete the selected bad segment
actions.label: Delete segment
actions.help: Click a segment to select it (it is drawn stronger), then Delete

actions.title: Save the bad channels and segments to the dataset
actions.label: Save to dataset
actions.help: Bad channels into the status column of _channels.tsv, bad segments as BAD_ rows of the run's _events.tsv (how mne-bids reads them back as annotations); one step in the Editor's history, so it can be undone

actions.title: Reset the view
actions.label: Reset view
actions.help: Back to the opening window, scale, channels and no filter

actions.title: Remove the filters
actions.label: No filter
actions.help: Back to the unfiltered signal

actions.title: Show events
actions.label: Events
actions.help: Event markers from the run's events.tsv, or the stim channel's triggers; turning them on jumps to the first when none is in view

actions.title: Power spectrum
actions.label: PSD
actions.help: Power spectral density (Welch) of the channels shown, of the raw or the filtered signal

actions.title: Line thickness and colours
actions.label: Line style
actions.help: Trace width, and one colour or a colour per channel type

actions.title: Every physio file of this run
actions.label: All of this run
actions.help: The cardiac trace, the belt and the trigger of one run on one clock: resampled onto the fastest grid, each at its own start time

actions.title: Zen mode: only the traces
actions.label: Zen
actions.help: Hide the toolbars and the overview and leave the traces the whole pane; Z again brings them back

actions.title: Close the signal
actions.label: Close
actions.help: Drop the signal and go back to the metadata

actions.title: Show the FID
actions.label: FID
actions.help: The time-domain signal the scanner measured, against seconds

actions.title: Metabolite positions
actions.label: Metabolites
actions.help: Labelled lines where the main metabolites resonate: NAA 2.01, creatine 3.03, choline 3.22, myo-inositol 3.56 ppm, and others

actions.title: Standard window (0.2 to 4.2 ppm)
actions.label: 0.2 to 4.2 ppm
actions.help: Frame the band where the proton metabolites are read

actions.title: Overlay the water reference
actions.label: Water reference
actions.help: The unsuppressed water acquisition of the same voxel (_mrsref), over the spectrum: its line width and frequency are the reference for quality

actions.title: Show the voxel on the anatomy
actions.label: On anatomy
actions.help: Where the spectrum was measured: the voxel outlined on this subject's anatomical image

actions.title: Fit the whole band
actions.label: Fit all
actions.help: Show the whole frequency range at a height that fits it

actions.title: Phase automatically
actions.label: Auto phase
actions.help: The zero-order phase that makes NAA, creatine and choline upright

actions.title: Fit the height without the water
actions.label: Ignore water
actions.help: Leave the residual water band (4.4 to 5.0 ppm) out of the height, so a water peak cannot flatten the metabolites; it then runs off the top

actions.title: Vertical zoom in (look under the peaks)
actions.label: Vertical zoom in (look under the peaks)

actions.title: Save a scene in this dataset...
actions.label: Save a scene in this dataset...
actions.help: THIS image with its overlays in their looks, the crosshair and the layout, saved in the dataset (.bidsmgr/viz/scenes) to open again or share with someone who has the dataset

actions.title: Save a mosaic figure...
actions.label: Save a mosaic figure...
actions.help: The mosaic (built in Controls > Mosaic) as a PNG at screen, print or poster resolution

actions.title: Show the command line...
actions.label: Show the command line...
actions.help: The bidsmgr-view call (or Python) that reproduces this view: to open it again, or render it to a PNG with no window

actions.title: Save the look as a preset...
actions.label: Save preset
actions.help: How the viewer looks and is arranged (layout, display, time course, 3-D look) under a name, to apply to ANY image later from Save > Apply a preset. Without saving, the viewer already keeps the look you leave it in

actions.title: Restore every viewer default...
actions.label: Restore every viewer default...
actions.help: Every viewer back as installed: layouts, display and 3-D look, clip planes, trace and spectrum options, panel sizes. Shortcuts and saved presets are kept

slice.does: Fit the window to a box

render.does: Rotate (a click without a drag moves the crosshair)
